rule: Match existing realization claim by ID, semantic identity, exact text or bounded lexical coverage; preserve ceilings
Descriptive text is not automatically a resolution outcome. Authored content still needs coverage when consequential patterns match.
Existing low-consequence proposal policy; rumors remain claims, not world truth. No new authority.
Narration cannot resolve success, movement or player agency without engine evidence.
Checks, damage, resources and movement require engine outcomes.
NPC/faction/access/quest changes require existing authorized mutations; structured declarations cannot self-authorize.
